name: Naples
tagline: Street life, pizza and ancient cities
summary: Use Naples for a dense urban day and a separate Pompeii excursion. Its archaeological collections make the ruins easier to understand and its food rewards leaving time between sights.
seasonNote: Hot summers make Pompeii tiring; carry water and choose early starts.
arrival: Airport buses and licensed taxis connect to central Naples; Centrale station serves intercity trains.
gettingAround: Walk historic clusters; use metro and local rail for longer legs. Keep valuables secure on crowded transport.
cashTip: Carry small EUR notes for bakeries and street food; cards work for larger spending.
foodTip: Try Neapolitan pizza, sfogliatella and espresso; a simple pizza meal can be excellent value.
buyTip: San Gregorio Armeno is known for nativity craft; choose handmade pieces and ask about packaging.
baseArea: Historic centre or near a convenient metro stop

connections.note: Typical fastest rail time; choose the correct departure station.
